research.finding: Voluntary employer reviews can overrepresent extreme opinions.
research.limitation: Ratings and review volume cannot establish a local operational cause by themselves.

research.finding: Recruitment word-of-mouth studies found that source and disclosed incentives influenced employer attractiveness.
research.limitation: Does not prove the success or harm of a given advocacy campaign.

research.limitation: Supplied sandbox reference. Verify the magnitude and applicability independently.
